mapper.select: SELECT FROM MARKETING_ASSET_PROJECT_APPLY a JOIN MARKETING_CUSTOMER_INFO c ON c.id=a.cust_id AND c.record_status='ACTIVE' WHERE a.record_status='ACTIVE' ORDER BY a.updated_time DESC,a.id DESC LIMIT #{offset},#{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MARKETING_ASSET_PROJECT_APPLY a JOIN MARKETING_CUSTOMER_INFO c ON c.id=a.cust_id AND c.record_status='ACTIVE' WHERE a.record_status='ACTIVE'
mapper.update: UPDATE MARKETING_ASSET_PROJECT_APPLY SET cust_id=#{entity.custId}, source_touch_task_id=#{entity.sourceTouchTaskId}, source_worklog_id=#{entity.sourceWorklogId}, project_name=#{entity.projectName}, project_type=#{entity.projectType}, biz_type=#{entity.bizType}, guarantee_type=#{entity.guaranteeType}, project_total_investment=#{entity.projectTotalInvestment}, project_loan_amount=#{entity.projectLoanAmount}, credit_amount=#{entity.creditAmount}, credit_exposure_amount=#{entity.creditExposureAmount}, is_urgent=#{entity.isUrgent}, is_key_project=#{entity.isKeyProject}, urgent_source=#{entity.urgentSource}, main_manager_id_snapshot=#{entity.mainManagerIdSnapshot}, main_org_id_snapshot=#{entity.mainOrgIdSnapshot}, updated_by=#{entity.updatedBy}, updated_time=#{entity.updatedTime}, lock_version=lock_version+1 WHERE id=#{entity.id} AND status='DRAFT' AND record_status='ACTIVE' AND lock_version=#{expectedVersion}

UPDATE MARKETING_ASSET_PROJECT_APPLY SET record_status='DELETED',updated_by=#{updatedBy},updated_time=#{updatedTime},lock_version=lock_version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND status='DRAFT' AND record_status='ACTIVE' AND lock_version=#{expectedVersion}

UPDATE MARKETING_ASSET_PROJECT_APPLY SET status=#{targetStatus}, completed_time=CASE WHEN #{targetStatus} IN ('COMPLETED','REJECTED','CANCELLED') THEN #{updatedTime} ELSE completed_time END, updated_by=#{updatedBy},updated_time=#{updatedTime},lock_version=lock_version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND status=#{expectedStatus} AND record_status='ACTIVE'

UPDATE MARKETING_ASSET_PROJECT_APPLY SET is_urgent=1,urgent_source='MID_PROCESS',updated_by=#{updatedBy},updated_time=#{updatedTime},lock_version=lock_version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND status='IN_APPROVAL' AND record_status='ACTIVE' AND is_urgent=0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MARKETING_ASSET_PROJECT_APPLY WHERE cust_id=#{custId} AND status='IN_APPROVAL' AND record_status='ACTIVE'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MARKETING_ASSET_PROJECT_APPLY WHERE applicant_emp_id=#{empId} AND record_status='ACTIVE'
